activity-feed.busy: Set while more items are loading; sets `aria-busy` on the feed.
activity-feed.now: Reference time for relative labels (defaults to the render time).

app-shell.fixed: Pin the header, or size the main area to the viewport so the page scrolls inside it.
app-shell.fluid: Let the main area use the full width instead of the content max width.
app-shell.fallback: Text shown while the avatar image is missing or loading.
app-shell.alt: Alternative text for the avatar image.

calendar.locale: date-fns locale for month and weekday names.

canvas.onDrop: Called with `{ source, target }` for every drop: a palette item or node onto a node edge or the empty area.
canvas.edge: Which edge of the node the indicator marks.
canvas.gap: Gap between the indicator line and the node edge.
canvas.data: Payload passed back untouched in `onDrop` when this palette item is dropped.

cascader.depth: Column depth, starting at 0 for the first column; sets `data-depth`.
cascader.path: Nodes from the first level down to the matched node.

chart.config: Series config: label, icon, and color (or theme colors) per data key; exposed as `--color-<key>`.
chart.id: Unique id for the generated style element.

comment-thread.authorId: Id of the person who wrote the comment.

gantt.progress: Completion from 0 to 100, drawn as the filled part of the bar.
gantt.links: Dependencies as `{ from, to }` bar ids, drawn as arrows.

hotkeys.hotkey: Key combination such as `mod+k`, or a sequence such as `g d`.

kanban.gap: Gap between the indicator and the edge.
kanban.height: Height of the drop slot, normally the dragged card's height.

node-graph.connected: Whether the port has at least one edge; sets `data-connected`.

popconfirm.showArrow: Render the arrow pointing at the trigger.

query-builder.group: The group node this part renders.
query-builder.rule: The rule node this part renders.

transfer-list.direction: `right` moves source to target; `left` moves target to source.

tree-select.showRemove: Render the remove button on the chip.
tree-select.indexPath: Position of the node in the tree.
